rules.title: Project.dat WDGAP
rules.statement: Default project setting WDGAP = 5: Weld fit-up gap (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat SCALLOP
rules.statement: Default project setting SCALLOP = 30: Flange scallop/cope radius (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat RCCR
rules.statement: Default project setting RCCR = 30: Column corner radius / related clearance (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat SHOLE
rules.statement: Default project setting SHOLE = 22: Default bolt hole diameter (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat ENDGAGE
rules.statement: Default project setting ENDGAGE = 40: End distance to first bolt row (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat HOLELEN
rules.statement: Default project setting HOLELEN = 60: Default slotted/long hole length related (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat stffsqgage
rules.statement: Default project setting stffsqgage = 60: Stiffener square gauge (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat STFFGAP
rules.statement: Default project setting STFFGAP = 0: Stiffener gap toggle/value.

rules.title: Project.dat STFFIN
rules.statement: Default project setting STFFIN = 0: Stiffener inset toggle/value.

rules.title: Project.dat SWS
rules.statement: Default project setting SWS = SS400: Default steel grade (legacy SS400; engine maps toward SS275).

rules.title: Project.dat WELDTIP
rules.statement: Default project setting WELDTIP = AWS_EXXXX_GRADE: Weld tip/electrode grade placeholder.

rules.title: Project.dat PAINT
rules.statement: Default project setting PAINT = SEE_PAINT_SPEC.: Paint specification note.

rules.title: Project.dat SET_COL_STFF_JBX
rules.statement: Default project setting SET_COL_STFF_JBX = 75: Column stiffener J-box related size.

rules.title: Project.dat SET_ASY_BOMLEN
rules.statement: Default project setting SET_ASY_BOMLEN = 73: Assembly BOM length field width/setting.

rules.title: Project.dat hs-dimrnd-box
rules.statement: Default project setting hs-dimrnd-box = 0.5: Dimension round-off (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat m32-dim-txt-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-dim-txt-box = 3: Dimension text height (paper mm).

rules.title: Project.dat m32-marktxt-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-marktxt-box = 1.6: Mark text height (paper mm).

rules.title: Project.dat m32-gridasy-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-gridasy-box = 5: Assembly grid text size.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-griddan-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-griddan-box = 4: Part grid text size.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-bom-txt-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-bom-txt-box = 1.5: BOM table text height.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-splise-gap-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-splise-gap-box = 5: Splice gap (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat m32-share1-gap-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-share1-gap-box = 5: Shear connection gap setting 1 (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat m32-share2-gap-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-share2-gap-box = 5: Shear connection gap setting 2 (mm).

rules.title: Project.dat m32-pipejun-ang-box
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-pipejun-ang-box = 3: Pipe junction angle tolerance.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-pipejun-las-123
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-pipejun-las-123 = 3: Pipe junction LAS setting.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-dimtad-pop
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-dimtad-pop = 2: DIMTAD dimension text above-line pop index.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-dimdec-pop
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-dimdec-pop = 1: DIMDEC decimal places pop index.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-dimlunit-pop
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-dimlunit-pop = 1: DIMLUNIT linear units pop index.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-gitabolt-pop
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-gitabolt-pop = 3: Gita/secondary bolt pop index.

rules.title: Project.dat m32-spgpbolt-pop
rules.statement: Default project setting m32-spgpbolt-pop = 0: Splice group bolt pop index.

rules.title: Project.dat set-bom-matl-elss-tog
rules.statement: Default project setting set-bom-matl-elss-tog = 1: BOM material ELSS toggle on.

rules.title: DetailRules scallop default 30
rules.statement: When Project.dat is missing SCALLOP, DetailRules.Scallop defaults to 30 mm.

rules.title: DetailRules end gauge default 40
rules.statement: EndGauge defaults to 40 mm (ENDGAGE).

rules.title: DetailRules hole dia default 22
rules.statement: HoleDia defaults to 22 mm (SHOLE) matching M20 + 2.

rules.title: DetailRules weld gap default 5
rules.statement: WeldGap defaults to 5 mm (WDGAP).

rules.title: DetailRules material default SS275
rules.statement: Engine default Material is SS275 when SWS missing (legacy Project.dat often SS400).

rules.title: DetailRules connection gap default 10
rules.statement: ConnectionGap (beam end to supporting web clearance) defaults to 10 mm.

rules.title: DetailRules text height 2.5 / dim gap 7
rules.statement: Paper text height 2.5 mm and dimension row gap 7 mm are drafting defaults.

rules.title: Min fillet leg for t≤6
rules.statement: Minimum fillet weld leg is 3 mm when thicker part thickness ≤ 6 mm (capped by thinner part).

rules.title: Min fillet leg for t≤12
rules.statement: Minimum fillet weld leg is 5 mm when thicker part thickness ≤ 12 mm (capped by thinner part).

rules.title: Min fillet leg for t≤20
rules.statement: Minimum fillet weld leg is 6 mm when thicker part thickness ≤ 20 mm (capped by thinner part).

rules.title: Min fillet leg for t≤>20
rules.statement: Minimum fillet weld leg is 8 mm when thicker part thickness ≤ ∞ mm (capped by thinner part).

rules.title: Fillet leg capped by thinner part
rules.statement: FilletLeg(t1,t2) = min(table_min(max(t1,t2)), min(t1,t2)).

rules.title: Standard hole bolt+2 (≤M22)
rules.statement: Standard hole diameter = bolt diameter + 2 mm for bolts up to M22.

rules.title: Standard hole bolt+3 (≥M24)
rules.statement: Standard hole diameter = bolt diameter + 3 mm for bolts M24 and larger.

rules.title: TS / S10T grade mapping
rules.statement: Bolt names starting with TS or containing S10T map to grade S10T (KS B 2819).

rules.title: HTB / F10T grade mapping
rules.statement: HTB / F10T names map to F10T (KS B 1010); F8T preserved as F8T.

rules.title: Ordinary M-BOLT grade
rules.statement: Names starting with M / SB or containing 4.6 map to M-BOLT.

rules.title: Unknown bolt name defaults F10T
rules.statement: Unrecognized bolt names default to F10T.

rules.title: Angle gauge AIJ/KS table
rules.statement: Angle leg gauges follow AIJ/KS table (e.g. L90→g1=50 max M24; L150→g1=55 g2=55).

rules.title: H/T flange gauge table
rules.statement: Flange gauge between bolt lines: W200→120, W250→150, W300→150, W350→140.

rules.title: Minimum edge distance practice 1.5d / 20
rules.statement: BoltGauges.For uses e = max(1.5*bolt, 20) mm as minimum edge distance practice.

rules.title: Default bolt by profile family
rules.statement: DefaultBolt: L by angle max; lip/Z 12 or 16; flat by depth; box/pipe by size; channel/H by depth bands.

rules.title: I/Channel web pitch 3d to 10mm
rules.statement: For I/Channel end connections, web pitch = ceil(3d/10)*10, rows capped at 6.

rules.title: Clear web T=D-2(tf+r)
rules.statement: Shear-tab plate must fit clear web depth T = D − 2(tf + r).

rules.title: Shop edge distance 40 mm
rules.statement: Vertical edge distance e ≥ max(40, MinEdgeSheared(d)).

rules.title: Shop pitch 70 mm / 3d
rules.statement: Pitch p ≥ max(70, ceil(3d/5)*5).

rules.title: Rows n=floor((T-2e)/p)+1
rules.statement: Bolt rows n = ⌊(T−2e)/p⌋+1; plate height 2e+(n−1)p ≤ T, centred.

rules.title: n<2 flagged
rules.statement: Fewer than 2 rows flags warning (AISC Manual Part 10 conventional 2–12).

rules.title: Prefer splice-standard WebY rows
rules.statement: ModelBuilder.ShearTab prefers SpliceStandards.WebY when present; else ShearTabLayout.Default.

rules.title: BoltPattern grammar
rules.statement: Plate/bolt string: thicknesses (*T)*, then X<axis>, Y<axis>, D<dia> in any order.

rules.title: BoltAxis nAp group
rules.statement: Axis term nAp means n intervals of pitch p → n+1 holes; plain terms are edges/gaps.

rules.title: HoleDia = BoltDia+2 in pattern
rules.statement: BoltPattern.HoleDia returns BoltDia+2 when BoltDia>0.

rules.title: SCSS S1–S10 web plate fields
rules.statement: SCSS row: S1 web t; S2–S5 web X; S6–S9 web Y; S10 web bolt dia.

rules.title: SCSS S11–S21 flange fields
rules.statement: S11/S12 flange plate t; S13 flange bolt dia; S14–S17 flange X; S18 gauge; S19 second gauge; S20–S21 edges.

rules.title: SCSS S22 splice gap
rules.statement: S22 is splice gap (typically 5 mm; Project.dat m32-splise-gap-box).

rules.title: Flange lines from S23
rules.statement: FlangeLines = max(2, FlangeBoltTotal/(4*FlangeX.Count)); 2 or 4 lines across flange.

rules.title: Web bolt count 2×rows×cols
rules.statement: WebBoltCount = 2 * WebX.Count * WebY.Count (both sides).

rules.title: Splice Find prefers bolt size then 22/20/16
rules.statement: SpliceStandards.Find tries requested size then 22, 20, 16 for C or G tables.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Column→C
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Column uses mark prefix 'C' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix SubColumn→SC
rules.statement: AssemblyType.SubColumn uses mark prefix 'SC' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Post→PT
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Post uses mark prefix 'PT' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Girder→G
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Girder uses mark prefix 'G' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Beam→B
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Beam uses mark prefix 'B' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix CraneGirder→CG
rules.statement: AssemblyType.CraneGirder uses mark prefix 'CG' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Brace→BR
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Brace uses mark prefix 'BR' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Purlin→PU
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Purlin uses mark prefix 'PU' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Girth→GT
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Girth uses mark prefix 'GT' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Rafter→RF
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Rafter uses mark prefix 'RF' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Truss→TR
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Truss uses mark prefix 'TR' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Stair→ST
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Stair uses mark prefix 'ST' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix HandRail→HR
rules.statement: AssemblyType.HandRail uses mark prefix 'HR' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: Assembly mark prefix Embed→EM
rules.statement: AssemblyType.Embed uses mark prefix 'EM' and centre-line layer CL-3D-* convention.

rules.title: RAFTER layer alias FAFTER
rules.statement: Layer CL-3D-FAFTER maps to AssemblyType.Rafter.

rules.title: Weld leader min 3 paper mm
rules.statement: Callouts.LeaderIfLongEnough omits leaders shorter than 3 paper mm × scale (COLLAB #3).

rules.title: HS-KOR text style txt+whgtxt
rules.statement: Korean text style HS-KOR uses txt.shx + bigfont whgtxt.shx (power-cad must create styles).

rules.title: Empty text excluded from power-cad payload
rules.statement: DrawingsToPowerCad drops text/mtext with empty string to avoid cad_create_many rejection.

rules.title: BOM workbook 9 sheets
rules.statement: Legacy BOM workbook schema targets 9 sheets (BomList, AssyList, cover, by-spec totals, …).

rules.title: Weight table density 7.85 unverified
rules.statement: REBORN weight_table agrees 775/775 vs section kg/m ±0.5%, but density 7.85 assumption remains unverified trust.

rules.title: Cut plan loss spec exists
rules.statement: 형강커팅플랜 cut_plan_spec defines cutting loss rules (derived, unverified).

rules.title: Command catalog 302
rules.statement: REBORN command_triage_v2 lists 302 commands; 232 linked to our command nodes.

rules.title: dwg_blocks_v2 verified
rules.statement: Only derived_spec with trust=verified is dwg_blocks_v2 (113 basenames match block table).

rules.title: VLX not decompiled into engine
rules.statement: hs02.VLX / HS-DETAIL.VLX are reference-only; behaviour reconstructed from FAS symbols and dialogs, not bytecode port.

rules.title: Dongle DLLs excluded
rules.statement: CSROCKEY2013 / r4nd_class / HsRockey are excluded (license dongle), never redistributed.

rules.title: 14 steel families in D2
rules.statement: Engine covers 14 families: H/BH/LH/PEB/I/T/ANGLE/CHANNEL/C-CHANNEL/Z/SQ-PIPE/STEEL-PIPE/ROUND-BAR/FLAT-BAR (+ plate).

rules.title: Section catalog skips Project and SCSS
rules.statement: SectionCatalog.Load skips Project.dat and SCSS-*.dat when scanning attributes.

rules.title: Model-first input
rules.statement: Primary input is the 3D/project model; drawings are projections (ARCHITECTURE §1).

rules.title: No AutoCAD.NET in Drafting
rules.statement: Drafting emits DrawPlan/DXF only; AutoCAD execution via power-cad, not AutoCAD.NET in Drafting.

rules.title: Deterministic rules
rules.statement: Same input → same DrawPlan; tests lock behaviour.
